name: Home Wrapped
description: Your home's year as Wrapped-style story slides, painted by GPT Image from what Home Assistant already knows: energy and solar, temperatures, doors, lights, telly, time away and the busiest rooms. Nothing to set up but an AI key; sample slides until then.

settings.name: fal_api_key
settings.label: fal.ai API key
settings.help: Blank uses the key under Settings › Generative AI (fal.ai, or OpenAI for GPT Image). Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys; it is only sent to fal.run.

settings.name: gen_daily_usd
settings.label: Painting budget per day
settings.help: The most the widget may spend on slides in a day, at GPT Image's listed price (about 20 US cents a slide). 0 is no limit.

choices.label: The whole story, a new slide each hour

cell_options.name: stat
cell_options.label: Which number
cell_options.help: 1 for the first thing found (solar, if there is any), 2 for the next, and so on.

cell_options.name: entities
cell_options.label: Things to count
cell_options.help: Any entity in Home Assistant, each counted its own way: lights, switches and doors by the times they came on, buttons and scenes by presses, automations by runs, a counting sensor (a litter box's cycles) by its rise, a measuring one by its average and peak. Picked, they are all that is painted, each shown in its own room, and all that runs along the foot. Blank lets the widget choose.

choices.label: Spectra: a colour e-paper panel's own inks

cell_options.name: cadence
cell_options.label: Repaint
cell_options.help: A slide keeps the numbers it was painted with until the next repaint. Changing the title, palette, home or pets repaints straight away.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Blank is Home Wrapped. The year follows it.

cell_options.name: home
cell_options.label: Your home, for the pictures
cell_options.help: A few words, such as 'a weatherboard cottage with a veranda' or 'a third-floor flat'.

cell_options.name: pets
cell_options.label: Your pets, for the pictures
cell_options.help: Such as 'a ginger cat and a black labrador'.

cell_options.name: foot_band
cell_options.label: Leave a band along the foot
cell_options.help: The painter leaves the bottom eighth plain, and it carries one of the year's events and the figures. Off paints the slide right to its bottom edge, with neither (it repaints straight away).

cell_options.name: show_strip
cell_options.label: Print the figures along the foot
cell_options.help: The numbers the slide was painted from, in small type, so a figure the painter got wrong is easy to spot (Repaint it from the widget's paintings page).
